t: What Mechanical Seal Database Is All About
title: What Mechanical Seal Database Is All About
description: Mechanical seals keep fluids in and air out: faces (carbon vs silicon carbide) lapped flat to light bands, springs holding contact, secondary O-rings static. Face materials pair hard-vs-soft; flush plans (API 682) cool and clean the faces. Dry running kills in minutes. Failure patterns — coked faces, O-ring extrusion, spring fatigue — read like the bearing book. This database is the complete seal record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
